en: Colorized, slightly worn card depicting a two‑storey brick and stone public building in a landscaped garden. The structure has large arched windows on the upper floor, pilasters and decorative friezes in a neoclassical style, red brick side wings, a low hipped roof with several chimneys, and a small manicured park with flowerbeds, paths, and trees in the foreground. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
